# Advanced Features

yt-dlp offers advanced features for more complex use cases. This guide covers advanced downloading options, playlist management, and custom configuration.

---

## Playlist Downloading

yt-dlp can download videos from YouTube playlists and channels. You can specify the playlist items to download using the `--playlist-items` option.

### Downloading Playlist Items

Download specific playlist items:

```bash
yt-dlp --playlist-items 1-10 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXt7w636R7lK6d5jYzXpXpXpXpXpXpXp
```

Download all playlist items:

```bash
yt-dlp --playlist-items 1-1000 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXt7w636R7lK6d5jYzXpXpXpXpXpXpXp
```

### Downloading Playlist Range

Download a specific range of playlist items:

```bash
yt-dlp --playlist-items 1-10 --playlist-start 5 --playlist-end 10 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXt7w636R7lK6d5jYzXpXpXpXpXpXpXp
```

---

## Channel Downloading

yt-dlp can download all videos from a YouTube channel. You can specify the number of videos to download using the `--playlist-items` option.

### Downloading All Videos from a Channel

Download all videos from a YouTube channel:

```bash
yt-dlp --all-formats --playlist-items 1-1000 https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXt7w636R7lK6d5jYzXpXpXpXpXpXpXp/videos
```

Download the first 100 videos from a YouTube channel:

```bash
yt-dlp --all-formats --playlist-items 1-1000 --playlist-start 1 --playlist-end
